criteria.evidence: Actual raw and hourly strict-null canonical branches synchronously serialize the reserved version-1 summary and original full fields into one body and one existing put. The whole UTF-8 opening frame, comma and LF fit 64 KiB; complete body admission remains 8 MiB before put. Public report objects and diagnostic day GET omit the reserved field. Actual groups preserve full field equality, raw/hourly coverage and repeated counts, one-put effects, before-put size refusal, reserved-name refusal and custom/empty/preset nonpersistence. Storage-summary limits do not apply to custom arrays.

Actual reader requests offset 0/length 65,536, distinguishes full-object size from received bytes, charges entire chunks and fallback transfers, decodes only bytes before LF, and validates marker/version/owner/consumed summary fields. Missing/overlong/malformed recognized frames are terminal; legacy fallback discards prefix facts and takes one bounded full version, with null-after-presence unavailable. Existing finite ratio, cell, output and conservative coverage guards remain. Independent fixed11 passed 28/92-day exact window parity and byte/request comparisons, malformed/UTF-8-tail/replacement/fallback cases, and the actual installed local R2 range primitive case.

Read the complete admitted plan/current criteria, actual seven deltas and relevant readers, all three new groups and eight retained controls, kit and complete worker/failure captures. Reconstructed seven retained failed-candidate source hashes and confirmed only two fixture corrections. The single independent final-byte command passed 11 with 34 unselected; final compiler/six-file zero-warning lint/seven-file whitespace reused. All 46 pins, 32 protected pins, seven exact forward/reverse deltas and contract remain unchanged before/after. No broader suite or benchmark.

limitations: Forward canonical format only. Single-body publication keeps summary and full fields together for these synchronous writer-owned results; existing swallowed write acknowledgements and concurrent canonical publication races are not repaired.

Managed window reads validate summary framing/owner/consumed fields, not unread grid/tail integrity or historical/external writer consistency. Day GET retains bounded full validation; unchanged public shapes are not an attestation of every old reader.

Legacy reads can require an additional charged prefix transfer and may refuse below 92 days. Older writers can restore coherent slower legacy JSON. No migration, sidecar, historical repair or universal long-window availability.
Application byte/cell/output limits do not prove memory/CPU/provider capacity. Text-only adapters materialize before checking bytes and must honor the requested range to gain the short-read path.

Policy compatibility, experimental maturity, six-month measurement, model/reference objectives, useful grid paging, fold/shard/config/tombstone bounds, native workload qualification and customer/release acceptance remain separate. No source/governance edits, external/cloud/deploy/customer-data/commit operations or full-package closure.
